description: NHFLOW 2D floating box of nhflow_2d_6dof_box driven by REEF3D::CORAL (Z 40 1, fluid_body, two-way): heave only through a CORAL prismatic joint with a PTO damper; the NHFLOW loads of the stage ends go to CORAL (provisional at the predicted pose, committed at the step's end), CORAL's artificial added mass (added_mass) keeps the coupling implicit; REEF3D_NHFLOW_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL compared.
